canonical_term_en: Perfect Immortality Across All Possible Dimensions
authoritative_interpretation_zh: 在所有可能維度之中真正的、沒有任何缺陷、例外或不完美的永生；不接受以任何不完美形式替代其原意。

ultimate_goal.meaning_of_dimension: Not fixed to currently observed physical spatial dimensions; possible physical, cosmological, logical or metaphysical dimensions require explicit definition and consistency analysis before formal quantification.

proposed_formalization.notation: For every dimension d in a clearly defined consistent domain D_possible, P(d) must hold without defect or exception.
proposed_formalization.caveat: This is a target specification, not a theorem of existence or a demonstrated physically realizable universal property. P and D_possible must be defined, with consistency and model-checking limits disclosed.
proposed_formalization.challenge: A finite computational procedure cannot in general establish an unconstrained universal claim over every conceivable model or dimension.

cosmic_relationship.role: Investigate physical limits and cosmological assumptions without weakening or replacing the stated perfect-immortality ideal.
examples: cosmic heat death and thermodynamic limits
possible temporal boundaries and causal structure
